name: Galahad
source:
The youngest of the Knights of the Round Table, a genius knight with top-notch sword and bow skills. He has gorgeous features that make him easily mistaken for a woman. He was born with a silver spoon in his mouth, so to speak, and he has extremely low regard for others besides himself. Phrases such as "I just don't care if I die" spring easily from his lips.

"Where's the fun in learning about someone else, really?"

[From in-game profile]
